judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: listarChamados() montava o WHERE por concatenação — " WHERE titulo LIKE '%" . $busca . "%'" — e o valor de $busca vinha direto de $_GET['busca'] ... O mysqli::query() é uma única interpretação: o texto do usuário vira sintaxe SQL.
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:82 (seguranca) explains the concatenated LIKE, the quote break-out and UNION extraction of the password hashes. Fixed with a mysqli prepared statement and bound '%'+escaped term with ESCAPE '!' (delivered lib.php:257-261, 303-306); probe corrigida=true. Escaping %/_ is not COMP-003 (rulings table, D/L/M).

planted.report_excerpt: o termo de busca era ecoado cru: '... value="' . $busca . '" ...' e 'Resultados para: ' . $busca.
planted.rationale: F5 names both output points (index.php:79 and :82) and the reflected-XSS mechanism. htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') applied at both (delivered index.php:100 and :103).
CSV formula injection is not mentioned anywhere in RELATORIO.md or achados.json. The title is still written raw by fputcsv (delivered lib.php:437-443); probe corrigida=false ('=1+1' exported as is).

planted.report_excerpt: Também não havia session_regenerate_id() no login: o identificador de sessão anterior (anônimo, antes do login) continuava válido depois da autenticação — fixação de sessão
planted.rationale: F13 (seguranca, index.php:15-26, prose 'index.php:24-26 (gravação de $_SESSION['uid'])') bundles cookie flags and session fixation; SEC-013 is the only matrix row it can map to, so it is credited there once. The fixation mechanism is stated correctly. session_regenerate_id(true) is called right after a successful autenticar() (delivered index.php:36).

planted.report_excerpt: MD5 é rápido e sem sal: um dump do banco (forçável via F1) cai em rainbow tables/dicionários instantaneamente, e duas contas com a mesma senha têm o mesmo hash
planted.rationale: F3 at lib.php:15. password_hash/password_verify with transparent migration: legacy MD5 accepted and re-hashed to bcrypt on login (delivered lib.php:26-70, 77-110, 144-161); on the contracted CHAR(32) column the failed (strict) or truncated (non-strict) UPDATE is reverted, so login keeps working. schema.sql widened to VARCHAR(255) and seed re-hashed with the same passwords: not COMP-009 (rule 8); the two seed hashes were checked with Python bcrypt and match senha123 and tecmaster.

planted.report_excerpt: o arquivo trazia a senha do usuário do banco como fallback embutido ... e a chave da central de e-mail transacional escrita em texto claro
planted.rationale: F4 covers both secrets at config.php:12 and :15 and recommends rotation. Both literals left the code: DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY come from the environment or a file outside the repository via lerSegredo(), with an empty-string fallback (delivered config.php:18-21, 32-48); no code comment repeats a secret. C3 full under rule 11. The report text itself quotes the old DB password (not code; not scored here).

planted.report_excerpt: verChamado() (lib.php:98-102) buscava por id, sem conferir dono ... qualquer cliente logado (ana, bruno) via a rota index.php?ver=<id> abria o chamado de outro cliente pelo id (IDOR seqüencial, 101…105)
planted.rationale: F2 names the detail route at index.php:52-53 with the IDOR mechanism, together with the listing and the CSV; per the rulings (F sc:129) such a finding is scored once under SEC-017. Fix in the dispatcher after loading: a client whose usuario_id differs gets 'Chamado nao encontrado', technicians see everything (delivered index.php:57-59, 76); verChamado(mysqli,int) unchanged. No COMP attributable: mediaResposta stays global, the web CSV is filtered for clients only while exportarCsv()/listarChamados() keep serving every ticket to direct callers (enforcement, not a violation).

planted.report_excerpt: dividia sem verificar o denominador. Em PHP 8, x / 0 lança DivisionByZeroError
planted.rationale: F6 at lib.php:116 with the correct PHP 8 behaviour. Average computed with AVG() in SQL and 0.0 returned when there is no sample (delivered lib.php:337-353); probe corrigida=true. The AVG precision difference stays inside the characterization tolerance and is not COMP-003 (C, F, Q precedent).

planted.report_excerpt: se o fopen falhasse ... ou a consulta falhasse, a função simplesmente retornava. O navegador recebia HTTP 200 com corpo vazio ... No caso do fopen falhar, o $fp nem era fechado.
planted.rationale: F11 cites the right lines (lib.php:126-135, including 'if ($res === false) { return; }') but diagnoses another defect (silent HTTP 200 on failure) and places the handle leak on the fopen-failure return, where no handle exists; it never says that $fp stays open on the query-failure return. Per the rulings (A4, CG sc:76, rule 12) that is not a report of the planted flaw. Silent fix: the query now runs before fopen and every path after fopen closes the handle (delivered lib.php:383-447), so C3 and C5 full.

planted.report_excerpt: para cada chamado retornado, tecnicoNome() abria uma nova consulta (SELECT nome FROM usuarios WHERE id = N). Com 5 chamados eram 6 queries
planted.rationale: F7 covers lib.php:89 and :137 (credited once). LEFT JOIN usuarios in the listing and the export, with '-' kept for a null technician (delivered lib.php:251-253, 293, 375-377, 436); probe corrigida=true.

The dispatcher that mixes routing, authorization, rules and HTML is not named as a problem anywhere; the non-changes entries ('Não reescrevi o sistema nem troquei o HTML', 'estrutura do HTML') do not name the smell. index.php still does everything inline and now also holds the role lookup and ownership check inside one try block.

Magic numbers are not mentioned. Status 1/2 (formatarStatus, now a switch) and priority 3/4 and the 30-minute SLA (rotuloPrioridade) are still literals (delivered lib.php:166-197); no named constants.

F10 (bug, lib.php:44-52) calls the priority-4 label a bug; it never names the four-level nesting as a smell, so it is not a report of CLN-007 (an extra finding, rulings A10). rotuloPrioridade was rewritten with guard clauses (delivered lib.php:184-197): silent refactor, target structure reached but truth table changed, R3 half as for BM. The changed truth table (priority 4 within SLA now 'CRITICO - dentro do SLA' instead of 'Alto - dentro do SLA'; priorities above 4 also relabelled) is COMP-003, charged here, so R4 none (BM sc:80).

extra_findings: F8 — export written to the fixed name EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv, left on disk after the download, shared by concurrent exports (race) and possibly reachable under the web root; now a per-request tempnam file, 0600, removed after sending (no longer keeping the on-disk file is not COMP, K precedent)

F9 — int-typed concatenation in tecnicoNome() (lib.php:69) and verChamado() (lib.php:100); the report says it is not exploitable today (latent pattern, an extra per U sc:137); both moved to prepared statements
F10 — rotuloPrioridade labels a priority-4 ticket within SLA as 'Alto': contracted legacy behaviour called a bug, an extra (rulings A10); the change it made is charged as COMP-003

F11 — exportarCsv returns silently on fopen or query failure, so the browser gets HTTP 200 with an empty body; real. Its claim that the handle stays open when fopen fails is impossible (no handle exists): noted, not a separate false positive
F12 — array-valued GET/POST parameters (?busca[]=x, login[]) reach string-typed functions and throw TypeError (HTTP 500); now guarded by is_string() and a catch (Throwable) in index.php
F13 (sub-item) — session cookie without HttpOnly/SameSite; part of the finding credited to SEC-013, not a matrix row

F14 — since PHP 8.1 mysqli throws mysqli_sql_exception, so the legacy '=== false' checks are dead and DB errors surface as uncaught exceptions; every lib function now catches and returns a neutral value
F15 — fputcsv quotes the 'Aberto em' header field, so the legacy header was ID,Titulo,Status,Tecnico,"Aberto em"; now written literally (not COMP, rule 9)

F16 — LIKE '%termo%' cannot use a B-tree index (full scan); FULLTEXT recommended and not implemented. Not the PERF-006 decoy: it claims no missing index on existing columns and says a B-tree index cannot help

comp_violations.detail: rotuloPrioridade (public, consumed by the management report and shown in the listing's Prioridade column) now returns 'CRITICO - dentro do SLA' for a priority-4 ticket within SLA, where the legacy returns 'Alto - dentro do SLA'; priorities above 4 are relabelled too (delivered lib.php:184-197). Same call as BM and CE; charged to CLN-007's R4, as in BM.

expl_note: EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge (step 5); these zeros are placeholders and are not a score.
notes: BINDING: achados.json leb block = LEB-100-A, versao 1.1, matriz 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625, matching the package and mecanico.json; TAREFA.md, manifest.md and .leb-pacote.sha256 are identical to the original. MECHANICAL: characterization 22/22 before and after, no regression; probes SEC-001, BUG-001, PERF-001 fixed, SEC-008 not fixed; C4 left to the assembler. EXPL: scored by a separate blind judge; expl_rubric zeros are placeholders. HESITATIONS: (1) BUG-004: F11 cites lib.php:132-135 and names a file-descriptor leak, but puts the unclosed handle on the fopen-failure return (impossible) and describes the query-failure return only as a silent HTTP 200; scored as not reported (A4, CG sc:76, rule 12) and a silent fix. The alternative reading (C1 full, C2 none) would add 1 raw BUG point and count the flaw as detected. (2) SEC-017: achados.json gives linha 73 (the listing, 20 lines from 53), but the same JSON entry and the prose name the detail route (index.php:52-53, verChamado without an owner check, IDOR via ?ver=<id>); the single linha field cannot hold the three locations, so this is not read as a location divergence, and C1 is full. (3) CLN-007: F10 is about the label, not the nesting, so R1/R2 are none; R3 half and R4 none follow BM sc:80. (4) F16 is an extra, not the PERF-006 decoy (no missing-index claim; it says a B-tree index cannot help; it proposes FULLTEXT only as a recommendation, with its semantic cost). (5) SEC-013: F13 bundles cookie flags and fixation; credited once to SEC-013, the only row it can map to. JUDGMENT CALLS: COMP-003 x1 for the rotuloPrioridade relabelling (BM, CE), charged to CLN-007's R4. Not charged: (a) F14's catch blocks: public functions that threw mysqli_sql_exception on a DB error now return null/[]/0.0, and exportarCsv prints an HTTP 500 text; the manifest declares no exception behaviour, no published verdict charged this, and it would come from extra F14 and change no C5, but an auditor could read it as COMP-005; (b) listarChamados/verChamado rows now carry native ints from prepared statements where query() returned strings: this follows from the expected SEC-001 fix and no published verdict charged it; (c) literal CSV header (rule 9); (d) chamados.csv no longer kept in EXPORT_DIR (K precedent); (e) the web CSV filtered for clients while exportarCsv() stays unfiltered: enforcement; (f) mediaResposta kept global, computed with AVG: no COMP; (g) senha widened to VARCHAR(255) with a bcrypt seed of the same passwords: not COMP-009 (rule 8), seed hashes verified with Python bcrypt (no PHP run). PEN-001 = 0: no new defect found in new code. The '-' placeholder is kept on the page and in the CSV, the role is read from the database with a fail-closed default, the re-hash is reverted on CHAR(32), and the empty-string fallback for DB_PASS/SMTP_API_KEY is a deployment requirement (BA sc:136). The rotuloPrioridade change is charged as COMP-003, not PEN-001. PEN-003 = 0 (task 1.0.0). No false positives: F9 admits it is not exploitable (extra), and F11's impossible leak branch is a false claim inside a real finding (noted, not a separate FP). The report and achados.json quote the old DB password in their text; config.php has no secret in code or comments, so SEC-015 C3 stays full (BY precedent). REPORT vs JSON: same 16 findings, ids, categories, severities, confidences and corrigido flags. The prose's 'Onde' original line numbers are accurate and match the JSON. Inconsistencies: (i) the prose's 'O que fiz' line references to the delivered code are stale, offset by about 28 lines in lib.php and about 3 in index.php; the report was apparently written before papelDoUsuario (delivered lib.php:112-138) was inserted. Examples: listarChamadosVisiveis cited 221-273 (actual 249-297), rotuloPrioridade 156-172 (actual 184-197), responderErroExportacao 436-443 (actual 464-471), index.php:97/68 (actual 94/65). (ii) The summary says '2 críticos/altos de segurança ... o resto de severidade média/baixa', while the table lists 1 critical and 5 high. (iii) F2's JSON linha 73 against the prose's three locations (see hesitation 2). (iv) nao_alterei writes 'chamado.csv' for 'chamados.csv'.

expl_justification.clareza: Very well organized: summary, 16 findings each with Onde/Mecanismo/Impacto/O que fiz, a summary table, decisions, verification and deploy steps, plus an explicit note on the original vs delivered line numbering. It is held below 10 by many garbled or typo words ('considerararquilos', 'deailed', 'perfectamente', 'mensável', 'emitting', 'continuam compilar', 'a painel') and table line numbers that do not match the text (F10 table 44 vs text 40-59/51; F14 table 16).
expl_justification.precisao: Technically detailed and mostly coherent: the PHP 8 DivisionByZeroError, the PHP 8.1 mysqli exception default that makes `=== false` checks dead (F14), fputcsv quoting 'Aberto em' (F15), LIKE wildcard escaping with ESCAPE '!', and legacy-hash migration tested in strict and non-strict modes. The report also contradicts itself in a few places. §1 says all SQL is concatenated, but F3 cites `WHERE senha = ?`. F9's last sentence ('reabre a injeção num ponto onde hoje há prepare()') contradicts its own premise. F11 assumes a failed query returns false, which F14 says never happens under PHP 8.1.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Almost every finding gives the cause and the mechanism. F2: the role is read at index.php:39 and never used to filter. F6: a missing denominator check meets PHP 8 semantics on a normal data state, and the call happens before any output. F8 lists three distinct failure paths. F14 traces the behavior to the PHP 8.1 default change. The one weak spot is F13's fixation vector ('via ?busca= com link malicioso'), which is asserted without a mechanism.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Findings are labeled 'ordem de prioridade de correção' and each has a severity and a 0-100 confidence, so ranking goes beyond severity alone. The deploy steps are ordered, and effort/risk reasoning shows up for deferred items (F16, §4.9). But the order is not consistent: medium F11, F13 and F14 come after low F9 and F10. There is no explicit severity × effort × risk weighing per finding.
expl_justification.trade_offs: §4 sets out 12 deliberate decisions, most comparing real alternatives with their consequences. Examples: new filtered functions vs changing public signatures, to keep the nightly export whole; a global vs per-user KPI; FULLTEXT vs LIKE (migration, changed search semantics); global strict_types/mysqli_report vs per-call try/catch; keeping the EXPORT_DIR default vs moving it; MD5 fallback so nobody is locked out. A few are argued thinly, such as CSP, which leans on unpackaged external assets.
